verses.t: By the fig and the olive
verses.pickthall: By the fig and the olive
verses.yusufAli: By the Fig and the Olive
verses.rodwell: I SWEAR by the FIG and by the olive
verses.sale: By the fig, and the olive

verses.pickthall: And by this land made safe

verses.t: We have certainly created man in the best of stature
verses.pickthall: Surely We created man of the best stature
verses.yusufAli: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds
verses.rodwell: That of goodliest fabric we created man
verses.sale: Verily We created man of a most excellent fabric

verses.t: Then We return him to the lowest of the low
verses.pickthall: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low
verses.yusufAli: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low
verses.rodwell: Then brought him down to be the lowest of the low
verses.sale: afterwards We rendered him the vilest of the vile

verses.t: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted
verses.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing
verses.yusufAli: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing
verses.rodwell: Save who believe and do the things that are right, for theirs shall be a reward that faileth not
verses.sale: Except those who believe, and work righteousness; for they shall receive an endless reward

verses.t: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense
verses.pickthall: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment
verses.yusufAli: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)
verses.rodwell: Then, who after this shall make thee treat the Judgment as a lie
verses.sale: What therefore shall cause thee to deny the day of judgment after this

verses.t: Is not Allah the most just of judges
verses.pickthall: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges
verses.yusufAli: Is not Allah the wisest of judges
verses.rodwell: What! is not God the most just of judges
verses.sale: Is not God the most wise judge
